{{Conjecture|legends}}
This '''person''' was the [[Executive officer/Legends|first officer]] of a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] crew<ref name="GG">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref> at some point after [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="WC">inferred because Tantor was born in 32 BBY as per [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']] and this person and Tantor worked together.</ref> This person was the second in command to [[Unidentified pirate captain (Tantor)|the pirate captain]].<ref name="GG" />

At some point, the brawler crewbeing [[Tantor (bounty hunter)|Tantor]] discussed with the captain and jettisoned the captain to outer space. The first officer replaced the captain and, mistrusting Tantor, decided to shackle the brawler for the other crewmember's safety. In the following stepover, Tantor freed himself and escaped, [[Death/Legends|killing]] a number of pirates in his way.<ref name="GG" />
